title: Wear app: Double-tab settings crash when scrolling down to end
body:
**AndroidAPS 3.0.0.2-dev-j**
**Build:** #7ef313e4aa
**Flavor**: Fullrelease

Watch: Samsung Galaxy Watch4 44mm
**Wear App:** from AAPS 3.0.0.2-dev-j, build#7ef313e4aa
Build: #??????

**Problem description:** 

Watch face menu cashes on settings

_Repro_:

1. Double-tab on watch face for settings menu
2. Select "Settings"
3. Scroll down

When scrolling down beyond "Show Loop Status" the config page crashes back to the watch face.

comments.body: uninstall wear app and install again
Had to uninstall/reinstall twice, but then it stopped crashing.

Menu started crashing again, now even worse disabling the entire watch face.
Reopening issue as https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/1728
